Package model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
Player class represents a player of the game. It is linked with a Table-position, and it defines all the properties of a player like the score, the status, the picked cards and the tokens he/her achieved during a game.
